☀️ **Almost About My Summer Playlist** 🎶  

This summer felt like it needed its own soundtrack. Not a perfect one, not a carefully curated one, just a mix that caught the vibe of sunshine, road trips, late nights, and those in-between moments. It’s almost about the songs, but really it’s about what they carried me through.  

Some tracks became background noise for long drives, others turned into instant mood boosters when I needed energy. A few surprised me by sticking around on repeat, weaving themselves into memories I’ll look back on years from now.  

The playlist isn’t polished or themed. It’s messy, nostalgic, and full of little sparks that made this season what it was. Almost about the music, but really? It’s about the moments the music held.
